renewalPlaceWeight.citation: How much the place's conditions, as the outcome web's factor on the birth rate, weigh in a couple's plan (the log of the factor, so a factor of 1 adds nothing). OPUS-WEB asked renewal to read births.rate's factor (BOARD, Oct 12); the size is a starting value to check against the web's factor and the births a year brings.

spread.reason: A starting value; 0.5 to 3 to be checked against the web's factor and a year's births once places differ in their web factors.

renewalApartPull.citation: How much living apart weighs against a child in a dating couple's plan (a couple at home weighs +1). Checked by the share of births to mothers with no partner at home: about 40% of US births are to unmarried mothers (NCHS NVSS, Births: Final Data for 2022) and about 58% of those to cohabiting couples (NSFG 2015-2019, NCHS NHSR 179), leaving about 17% of births to mothers with no partner at home. Set Oct 13, 2026 at wait pull 3 over six drawn towns: dating couples' births 2 of 53 at 0.5, 3 of 54 at 0, 6 of 57 at -1; the share stays near 6-11% whatever the pull, because few couples date long before moving in, so 0 (living apart counts for nothing, against +1 at home).
